name: Master of Cultural Studies
curriculum: Structure — 72 credit points, including: 12 credit points of core units of study; a minimum of 24 credit points from selective units of study; a maximum of 24 credit points from elective units of study; and a minimum of 12 credit points of capstone units of study (research on a topic of your choice)

name: Graduate Diploma in Criminology
curriculum: Structure — 24 credit points, equivalent to 4 units of study; one compulsory unit of study, Explaining Crime; the remaining units of study are selected from a wide range of electives

name: Graduate Diploma in Cultural Studies
curriculum: Structure — 48 credit points (8 units of study), including: a minimum of 30 credit points from core electives; and a maximum of 18 credit points from elective units of study

name: Graduate Diploma in English Studies
curriculum:
Structure — 48 credit points, including: a minimum of 24 credit points of core units of study; and a maximum of 24 credit points from elective units of study
Areas of literary study — Medieval literature; Early modern literature; 18th- and 19th-century literature; Modern and contemporary literature; British, American and Australian literature; Various aspects of cultural theory; Creative writing units in contemporary poetry, fiction and creative non-fiction (optional)

name: Graduate Diploma in International Law
curriculum: Structure — 24 credit points, equivalent to 4 units of study; one compulsory unit of study, International Law I; the remaining units of study are selected from a wide range of relevant electives

name: Graduate Diploma in Taxation
